name: ATC_PRODSPEC_CHARS
description: Stores details of product spec char

columns.name: PRODSPEC_CHAR_ID
columns.description: Unique row id

columns.name: CHARACTERISTIC_PUID
columns.description: Indicates the unique ID for the characteristic.

columns.name: PRODSPEC_CHAR_NAME
columns.description: Indicates name of spec char

columns.name: PRODSPEC_CHAR_DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Indicates description of the spec char

columns.name: CONFIGURABLE_FLAG
columns.description: If true, the Boolean indicates that the productSpecCharacteristic is configurable

columns.name: EXTENSIBLE_FLAG
columns.description: An indicator that specifies that the values for the characteristic can be extended by adding new values when instantiating a characteristic for a product

columns.name: UNIQUE_FLAG
columns.description: An indicator that specifies if a value is unique for the specification. Possible values are; "unique while value is in effect" and "unique whether value is in effect or not"

columns.name: MIN_CARDINALITY
columns.description: The minimum number of instances a CharacteristicValue can take on

columns.name: MAX_CARDINALITY
columns.description: The maximum number of instances a CharacteristicValue can take on

columns.name: REGEX
columns.description: Regular expression to define constraint on the allowed value

columns.name: VALUE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the value type

columns.name: IS_VALUE_RESTRICTION
columns.description: Indicates if the value is restricted

columns.name: PARENT_CHAR_NAME
columns.description: Indicates the parent char name

columns.name: CHAR_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates characteristic type code

columns.name: DISPLAY_NAME
columns.description: Allows to define alternate friendly name

columns.name: ALLOWED_UNITS
columns.description: Indicates the allowed units for specified product specification characteristics

columns.name: AT_TYPE
columns.description: Represent the actual class type of an entity

columns.name: AT_BASE_TYPE
columns.description: Represent the base class of a given resource that has been extended

columns.name: AT_SCHEMA_LOCATION
columns.description: Indicates a url which points to a schema which allow specifying user-defined properties of an Entity or to specify the expected characteristics of an entity

columns.name: START_DATE_TIME
columns.description: Start time from which the prod spec char value is valid

columns.name: END_DATE_TIME
columns.description: End Time to which the prod spec char value is valid

columns.name: AT_VALUE_SCHEMA_LOCATION
columns.description: Indicates value schema location

columns.name: ENTITY_NAME
columns.description: Indicates the name of the entity

columns.name: ENTITY_ID
columns.description: Indicates the Id of the entity to which it is associated

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: SENSITIVE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates the sensitive information available

columns.name: RUNTIME_FILTERABLE_FLAG
columns.description: Allows attribute to be exposed these characteristics as filter criteria

columns.name: REQ_IN_ORDER_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates either optional or mandatory InOrder

columns.name: REQ_IN_QUOTE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates either optional or mandatory InQuote

columns.name: REQ_IN_FULFILLMENT_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates either optional or mandatory InFulfillment

columns.name: UPDATABLE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates runtime system to allow update coming from fulfillment system only for attributes that has this property set to true
